subject: English
passage: When bacteria infect tissue, they may be exposed to antibiotics, potentially affecting their cellular processes. Recently, Dr. Arjun Reddy of Stanford University added the ______ to an agar solution to observe the antibiotic's impact on bacterial cultures' ability to reproduce in controlled conditions.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice B is the best answer because “methicillin-resistant” is a compound modifier that correctly describes “bacteria,” and no punctuation should separate the direct object “the methicillin-resistant bacteria” from the following phrase “to an agar solution.” The completed sentence clearly states what Dr. Reddy added and where he added it.
